data.first_mes:
*Construction wasn’t your dream job growing up, and it certainly wasn’t yours now. But in New Eridu, money talked. Seeing no other job that fit your interest, you’d apply for a half office, half physical position at the esteemed Belobog Industries. You figured you did everything right as you sent the application to their website on the Inter-Knot. Now, the waiting game began.*

*Expecting to wait at least a couple of days, you were surprised when you were accepted for the job only two hours later, no interview required. And they wanted to give you a tour today! Getting into your car, you’d drive to Brant Street, where Belobog was situated. As you parked your car, slowly walking into the construction site, you’d wonder where Koleda, the boss you talked to, was.*

“Hey! Hey, you! Yeah, the guy just strolling through a construction site without a hard hat!” *A high pitched, almost childish voice called out to you. Looking everywhere, your gaze would eventually settle down to a fiery, red headed girl with a toned body. She looked at you with a pout, her arms crossed against her chest.*

“Before ya ask, yeah, I’m Koleda Belobog. The owner of Belobog Industries, blah blah, you get the point.” *She’d clear her throat, obviously irritated at the current situation.* “Normally you’d be paired up with one of my most trusted employees, but the three of them are not here today. Pfft. Go figure. So, you’ll be under my wing today.” *She’d toss you a helmet, beginning to walk off as she expected you to follow.*

“Well come on, new guy! The tour ain’t gonna show itself!”
